scope: read-only fixed-source contracts for ordinary dual-UID HAP audio runtime observation; no runtime acceptance or authorization action performed

provenance.queries: Bounded Python Path reads/hash/exact snippets and git rev-parse only; container rg unavailable.

readonly_commands.name: uid_records
readonly_commands.uid_input: Actual HAP UID from runtime identity; canonical non-negative decimal. Dumper uses atoi, so never pass unvalidated input.

audio_recording.name: audioRecording
audio_recording.parse_modes: Comma-separated integers; vector printer emits trailing comma. Parse exact integers, not substring '3' (13 is a different mode). backgroundMode is only the selected primary mode; use backgroundModes membership for batch API.

output.first_line_handling: Remove only leading No.<decimal> before extracting fields; UID dump begins No.N immediately followed by two tabs and abilityName.
output.uid_filter_source: GetAllContinuousTasksInner skips record when record.uid_ != requested uid; taskInfo retains uid/pid/notificationId/continuousTaskId.

observation_contract: Observe each actual HAP UID separately; require UID/pid/task IDs to match that app's runtime identity.
Join UID records to --all on uid, pid, continuousTaskId; require suspendState=false for an unsuspended task assertion.
Require exact mode integer 3 in backgroundModes. A returned record or API success alone does not prove continuous unsuspended recording.
Take read-only snapshots around start/background/stop for both UIDs and retain raw stdout/stderr/service errors. No record for one UID must be attributed to the other.
Combined notification settings and optional subNotificationId can affect one-task/one-notification assumptions; inspect --all fields.

admission.caller: ShellDump requires shell token or native token; HAP token rejected.
admission.empty_caution: GetDumpInfo ignores the ShellDump return and may print no notification when permission/queue work failed; do not treat that text alone as successful absence.

correlation.ordinary_hap: For ordinary non-agent HAP publish, actual service stamps creator UID/PID from IPC; default owner UID becomes that caller UID. Parse the active dump's actual uppercase OwnerUid/OwnerBundleName/Id/Label fields, not NotificationRequest::Dump lowercase keys.
correlation.background_service_notification: NotificationTools sets creatorUid=serviceUid and ownerUid=continuousTaskRecord.uid. The task's HAP PID is in background task output; notification CreatePid can be a service PID.
correlation.notification_assignment: PublishNotification assigns/reuses notificationId; only after PublishNotification returns success does it retain notificationLabel and new notificationId in the task record.
negative_boundaries: The same numeric notification Id under another OwnerUid is not this HAP's notification.
Do not join only by label, array index, No.N, or CreatePid.
For ordinary application notifications additionally compare the actual OwnerBundleName and the known request ID; for combined task notifications inspect parent/sub IDs and labels.

routing.rule: configPolicy.getCfgFiles loads config files in order. If deviceInfo.isPc is defined, selects PC; code checks !== undefined, not boolean truth. Later isTv/isCar can override. Inspect actual guest configuration/page before choosing selectors.

require: Actual visible dialog with this HAP's resolved title/label
Visible and enabled Button component with exact current-locale resource text
Unique visible match inside that dialog; do not select by index
selectors.phone_duplicate_button_note: Phone has both horizontal and single-row BAN/ALLOW button layouts controlled by visibility. Match a visible button, not all text nodes.

callback.ordinary_hap_identity: onSessionCreate copies ohos.aafwk.param.callerBundleName/callerUid into want.parameters.bundleName/bundleUid for callers other than SceneBoard/SystemUI.
callback.failure_caution: SetNotificationsEnabledForSpecialBundle errors are logged but HandleOneDialogClosed still executes. Dialog disappearance or callback alone is not proof that enablement persisted. Follow with the HAP's own read-only enablement query and actual active notification observation.

limitations: Contracts are static fixed-source evidence; no UI, runtime dump, notification publish, authorization click, guest shell, service mutation, build or heavy task was performed.
Selected resources cover base/en_GB/zh_CN/zh_HK/zh_TW. Other installed locales must be resolved from their actual resource file before selecting text.
The actual guest HAP UIDs/PIDs, application labels, locale, configuration overlay, available dump feature and live hierarchy must be observed by the parent.
This support does not close audio requirements, network gaps, or the first newly packaged artifact runtime gate.
